asked.item: Brian is in my voice list though?
scenes fields in the request body (text, description)

verdict.reason: The help pages state that the shortened name "Brian" is not a valid value for this template and give the exact value to use, which explains the 400 error.

steps.text: The shortened name "Brian" is not a valid voiceName value for the AI Video with AI Voice template.
Send the exact enum value, such as "Brian (American, deep)", in inputs.voiceName.
Each scene in scenes needs a script field for the voiceover text and a mediaSource field.
